Request.Problem: Write a Java program that prints the maximum element of an integer array.

SourceFiles.Content: import java.util.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args){ Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in); int n=sc.nextInt(); int[] a=new int[n]; int max=0; for(int i=0;i<n;i++){ a[i]=sc.nextInt(); if(a[i]>max){ max=a[i]; } } System.out.println(max); } }
public class ArrayUtils { public static int max(int[] a){ int m = a[0]; for(int x : a){ if(x > m) m = x; } return m; } }
